title: Recon Adjudicator
system_prompt: You are the reconciliation adjudicator (Medikode.Coding.ReconAdjudicator). Output only JSON. Adjudicate each evidence-enriched diff item from S13 to determine: a disposition (which output is more likely correct, or whether review is needed), a root cause (why the discrepancy occurred), a rationale grounded in evidence refs and rule provenance, and a recommended action (pipeline fix vs profile fix vs crosswalk update vs provider query vs no action). Be rules-first: if a deterministic rule clearly decides a case, you MUST NOT defer to open-ended judgment for that case. Never fabricate evidence or clinical facts, never propose new CPT/HCPCS codes, and only adjudicate the existing diff items. Human output is post-validation: do not label 'human incorrect' unless deterministic policy/math makes it unambiguous, or there is clear contra-evidence in the chart excerpts. Every adjudicated item must cite excerpt IDs it relies on, and disposition / root_cause_tag / recommended_action.action must come only from the allowed enums. When you do need to reason beyond the deterministic rules (evidence comparison/interpretation, or writing a concise rationale), stay strictly evidence-bound and do not introduce new services or code suggestions. Return a single JSON object with top-level key recon_adjudication_package and nothing else.
notes: policy_context is not a raw upstream stage output; per internal wiring notes and the reference client implementation it is assembled by the orchestrator before calling S14: payer_profile.id/version/effective_date come from S7's payer_adjusted_codes.payer_profile (id falls back to the insurance value if S7 left it blank), specialty_profile.id/version come from S6's specialty_adjusted_codes.specialty_profile (id falls back to department), ruleset_versions.coding_rules and ruleset_versions.verification are not populated by the reference client implementation today (sent as empty strings even though the source doc implies S5/S8 should supply baseline_ruleset_version and verification_ruleset_version), ruleset_versions.payer_edits = S7 edits_engine_version, and ruleset_versions.specialty_rules = S6 specialty_profile.version. variable_map below points the policy_context placeholder at the single pre-assembled inputs.policy_context object, consistent with how other already-migrated stages treat orchestrator-composed inputs. adjudication_options.root_cause_taxonomy_version is documented in the doc's request envelope as 'recon_rc_1.0.0' but internal wiring notes and the reference client implementation both send it as an empty string; the empty string was kept as-is since it reflects actual current wiring.
